# Habib Blacksmith & Aluminum Co. (شركة حبيب للحدادة والألمنيوم) — Technical Machine Specs & Capabilities

> Habib Blacksmith & Aluminum Co., located in Riyadh (Al-Sulai), provides professional B2B CNC fiber laser cutting, metal forming, CNC press brake bending, lathe turning, and custom architectural metal fabrication across Saudi Arabia.

## Key Capabilities & Equipment
- Fiber Laser Cutting Services: Precision cutting from 1 mm up to 40 mm thickness[cite: 15].
- Maximum Sheet Bed Support: Available in 3 meters and 6 meters panel widths[cite: 15].
- Machinery Setup: Advanced Italian and German machinery for high-accuracy fabrication[cite: 16].
- Location: Riyadh, Al-Sulai, Exit 18, Eastern Ring Road Frontage / Old Industrial Area[cite: 1, 39].

## Materials & Thickness Specifications
- Stainless Steel: 1 mm to 30 mm[cite: 15]
- Aluminum: 1 mm to 40 mm[cite: 15]
- Brass & Copper: Up to 6 mm[cite: 15]

## Secondary & Fabrication Services Offered
- CNC Press Brake Bending & Shaping (Angles, Columns, and Custom Profiles)[cite: 15]
- Metal Turning Lathe Operations (مخرطة معادن) for custom mechanical shaping[cite: 15]
- Industrial Welding: Iron, Steel, and Aluminum (Argon Welding)[cite: 15]
- Architectural & Structural Works: Custom Doors, Partitions, Facades, Cladding, Curtain Walls, and Skylight Spider Systems[cite: 15, 16]

## Accepted CAD File Formats for Quoting
- 2D Formats: .DXF, .DWG
- 3D Formats: .STEP, .STP, .SLDPRT, .IGES
